quality_issues.quote: bigger environments where there are hundreds of certificates issued
quality_issues.suggestion: Define 'bigger environments' quantitatively: e.g., 'clusters with 500+ Certificate CRs' or 'environments issuing 100+ certificates per hour'.

quality_issues.quote: high number of certificates at once
quality_issues.suggestion: Quantify 'high number': e.g., '200+ certificates within a 5-minute window during DR failover'.

quality_issues.quote: Speed up the certificate issue process
quality_issues.suggestion: Add measurable acceptance criteria: 'Given a cluster with 500 pending Certificate CRs, When cert-manager reconciles with tuned parameters, Then all certificates are issued within 10 minutes (vs 30 minutes baseline)'.
